TermuxPP, Termux:API and Termux:Tasker share one user id. Replacing any one of them ends the processes of all of them: open terminal sessions and running tasks stop. Apps are updated one at a time; nothing is installed in the background.
Shizuku is not installed. Install it and start it to update from here.

Ready. Updates are installed through Shizuku.
No published TermuxPP build is available yet.
This build cannot be compared with the published one (a local build, not on the main branch, or a different history). No update is offered.
Installing. All TermuxPP apps restart when it is done.
Checks installed apps and compatible add-on releases. Contacts GitHub only when you tap.

Build %2$s of %1$s will be downloaded, verified against its published checksum and the signing certificate of the installed apps, and installed through Shizuku.\n\nTermuxPP, Termux:API and Termux:Tasker share one user id, so Android ends the processes of all of them when %1$s is replaced.
